ValidationRule.description: If Request Type = Tier Retain – Mbr can only be retained in Exp Month or Case = Sales Offers, Frequent Flyer Expiry Date is mandatory
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISBLANK(Freq_Flyer_Expiry_Date__c),
OR ( Case__r.RecordTypeId = "01290000001UPUR", /*Sales Offers Request*/ ISPICKVAL( Request_Type__c , "Tier Retain – Mbr can only be retained in Exp Month") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If Request Type is 'Tier Retain – Mbr can only be retained in Exp Month' OR If you are requesting a Sales Offer, , please fill in the Expiry Date.
